title: Mechanisms underlying the amplification of chronic restraint stress vulnerability in adult mice by adolescent social isolation stress and the ameliorative effect of light treatment.
summary: Early-life stress is a critical determinant of vulnerability to later-life affective and cognitive dysfunction, yet the mechanisms through which adolescent adversity enhances adult stress susceptibility remain incompletely understood. Here, we employed a two-hit model combining adolescent social isolation stress (SIS) with adult chronic restraint stress (CRS) to examine how developmental stress interacts with adult stress exposure. SIS alone or CRS alone exerted minimal behavioral effects, whereas SIS followed by CRS markedly potentiated depression-like behaviors and impaired spatial and object recognition memory. Two-hit stress produced robust hippocampal neuroinflammatory responses, including increased astrocytic and microglial activation and elevated TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, and IL-17A levels. These inflammatory alterations were accompanied by pronounced suppression of the BDNF/TrkB/p-CREB signaling cascade, reduced synaptic protein expression, and diminished dendritic spine density and branching complexity in CA1 pyramidal neurons. Notably, light treatment (LT) administered during CRS exposure significantly reversed two-hit induced behavioral deficits, attenuated glial activation and cytokine upregulation, enhanced BDNF/TrkB and p-CREB signaling, and restored synaptic and structural plasticity. Together, these findings indicate that adolescent SIS primes the hippocampus for exaggerated neuroinflammatory and neuroplastic impairments following adult stress, thereby amplifying stress vulnerability. Furthermore, LT emerges as a safe non-pharmacological intervention capable of mitigating combined stress-induced emotional and cognitive dysfunction by targeting neuroinflammatory and neurotrophic pathways.

标题：青少年社会隔离应激增强成年小鼠慢性束缚应激易感性的机制及光疗的改善作用
摘要：早期生活应激是后期情感和认知功能障碍易感性的关键决定因素，然而青少年期不良经历增强成年期应激易感性的机制尚不完全清楚。本研究采用双打击模型，结合青少年社会隔离应激与成年慢性束缚应激，探讨发育期应激如何与成年期应激暴露相互作用。单独的社会隔离应激或慢性束缚应激对行为影响甚微，而社会隔离应激后继慢性束缚应激显著加剧了抑郁样行为，并损害了空间和物体识别记忆。双打击应激引发海马强烈的神经炎症反应，包括星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞激活增加，以及TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6和IL-17A水平升高。这些炎症改变伴随BDNF/TrkB/p-CREB信号级联的显著抑制、突触蛋白表达减少，以及CA1锥体神经元树突棘密度和分支复杂度降低。值得注意的是，在慢性束缚应激暴露期间给予光疗显著逆转了双打击诱导的行为缺陷，减轻了胶质细胞激活和细胞因子上调，增强了BDNF/TrkB和p-CREB信号，并恢复了突触和结构可塑性。综上所述，本研究表明青少年社会隔离应激使海马对成年应激后的过度神经炎症和神经可塑性损伤产生易感倾向，从而放大应激易感性。此外，光疗作为一种安全的非药物干预手段，通过靶向神经炎症和神经营养通路，能够减轻联合应激诱导的情感和认知功能障碍。
关键词：社会隔离应激；慢性束缚应激；情绪障碍；神经炎症；光疗
